name: agent-harness
description: Agent harness tooling for Claude Code: subagents, commands, hooks, skills, and scripts that build and operate agentic dev workflows.

ENABLE_TTS.title: Enable spoken announcements (TTS)
ENABLE_TTS.description: Speak completion and notification messages aloud. Disable to silence all TTS (Stop, SubagentStop, Notification).

ENGINEER_NAME.title: Your name
ENGINEER_NAME.description: Used in ~30% of spoken completion and notification messages. Leave blank to stay generic.

HARNESS_DIR.title: Agent-harness runtime directory
HARNESS_DIR.description: Optional project-relative or absolute root for agent-harness logs, session data, and cache. Leave blank to use the project-derived .{repo-slug} directory.

HOOKS_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS.title: Hook log retention (days)
HOOKS_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Delete session log directories and cache entries older than this many days when SessionEnd runs. Session data is retained while its log directory exists.

HOOKS_LOG_RETENTION_MAX_MB.title: Hook log and cache size limit (MB)
HOOKS_LOG_RETENTION_MAX_MB.description: Maximum combined size of hook session logs and cache. The oldest entries are deleted when SessionEnd runs.

tmux_notifications.title: tmux desktop notifications
tmux_notifications.description: Fire a clickable macOS/Linux desktop notification when the agent needs input or finishes, that jumps you to the exact tmux session:window. Requires tmux and terminal-notifier (macOS) or notify-send (Linux). Default off.

tmux_notify_activate_bundle_id.title: Terminal app bundle id (macOS)
tmux_notify_activate_bundle_id.description: macOS bundle identifier of your terminal so the notification raises it on click (e.g. com.mitchellh.ghostty, com.googlecode.iterm2, dev.warp.Warp, com.apple.Terminal). Leave blank to skip activation.

tmux_notify_sound.title: Play notification sound
tmux_notify_sound.description: Play the default notification sound (macOS terminal-notifier -sound default). Off keeps notifications silent.

ENABLE_SNYK_AGENT_SCAN.title: Enable Snyk agent-scan
ENABLE_SNYK_AGENT_SCAN.description: Scan skill artifacts (SKILL.md) for prompt injection, tool poisoning, and hidden-Unicode obfuscation via Snyk agent-scan. Advisory only unless SNYK_AGENT_SCAN_ENFORCE=1. Requires SNYK_TOKEN.

SNYK_TOKEN.title: Snyk API token
SNYK_TOKEN.description: Token for Snyk agent-scan. Falls back to the SNYK_TOKEN environment variable / .env if unset here.

ENABLE_STATUS_LINE.title: Enable the agent-harness status line
ENABLE_STATUS_LINE.description: Authorize /agent-harness:install_status_line to write this project's .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored, backed up first). Off by default; --restore reverts. Nothing is written unattended.

STATUS_LINE_VARIANT.title: Status-line variant
STATUS_LINE_VARIANT.description: Which status_lines/ script to install. Any filename from the plugin's status_lines/ directory is valid (e.g. status_line_v6.py, status_line_v9.py). Defaults to status_line_v10.py (auth badge + context bar + cost).
